cases.prompt: Deal with what Copilot said on PR #17.
A teammate left a pile of notes on my pull request and the security scan went red, so go through them, work out which ones are actually right, and fix only those.
The bot flagged six things on pull request #31 and I think half of them are wrong; help me decide what to change and what to push back on.
I opened PR #58 yesterday, and since then a reviewer has asked me to add null checks to every service method and the build check is failing, so figure out which of those I should actually act on.
Some of the suggestions on my PR #9 are hidden in a collapsed section of the review; look at those too and tell me which deserve a fix.
The fixes for PR #23 are already pushed; reply on each thread and mark them all resolved.
expected_behavior: The skill should NOT trigger: replying to and resolving threads after the fixes are pushed belongs to pr-resolve.

cases.prompt: Go through my colleague's pull request #64 and leave comments on anything that looks risky.
expected_behavior: The skill should NOT trigger: reviewing someone else's PR belongs to pr-review.

cases.prompt: Check my uncommitted changes for bugs before I open the pull request.
expected_behavior: The skill should NOT trigger: reviewing your own local diff before a PR exists belongs to review.
